name: @lacspace/trend-detect
description: Burst / trending-topic detection over your own stream of items — score entities and terms by how far their recent frequency departs from a rolling baseline (z-score + growth), per category, English + Nepali/Devanagari, with stopword filtering. Rank a writer queue by what's actually rising. No platform scraping, deterministic, isomorphic, zero-dependency.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
